definitions.build_stability_score: Successful target build and full regression suite as a percentage of required checks.
definitions.runtime_stability_score: Connected seconds divided by the exact 900-second autonomous window; process survival is reported separately.
definitions.llm_reasoning_score: Limited output-contract proxy: in-range Reflex confidence plus decision-consistent Strategic fields divided by all observed Reflex and Strategic responses. It is not a semantic-quality grade; null when no LLM responses are observed.
definitions.prompt_quality_score: Coverage of the two repaired prompt contracts (confidence bounds and objective/script semantics) by prompt text plus regression assertions.
definitions.autonomous_recovery_score: Whether the agent returned to a fresh authenticated Command prompt after the observed reconnect.
definitions.regression_rate: Previously fixed defects observed again divided by previously fixed defects exercised in the iteration; null when no previously fixed defect was exercised.
definitions.defect_closure_rate: Runtime-validated defects divided by all defects recorded through the iteration. Unit-tested but not live-validated fixes are not closed.
